speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, mild fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. To begin our assessment, how long have these symptoms been present, and does the abdominal pain localize to any specific area?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old female. The patient describes a 3-week history of generalized fatigue, mild fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. She recalls attending the state fair over a month ago where she tried various regional foods. Recently, she has observed the darkening of her urine, which she believes is due to inadequate water intake. She has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. The 3-week duration, history of type 2 diabetes, recent fair attendance, and specifically the darkening of your urine are significant. Given the possibility of an infectious etiology affecting the liver, I need to confirm if you have experienced yellowing of your eyes or skin.

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel
REQUEST TEST: Urine_Analysis

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Vital_Signs: Temperature 38.1°C (100.6°F), Blood_Pressure 110/74 mm Hg, Heart_Rate 99/min, Respiratory_Rate Normal; General_Examination: Appearance tired, Jaundice Mild scleral icterus observed; Abdominal_Examination: Inspection No visible abnormalities, Auscultation Normal bowel sounds, Percussion No abnormalities detected, Palpation Liver palpated 2–3 cm below the right costal margin, tender on palpation; Blood_Tests: Hemoglobin 10.6 g/dL, Leukocyte_Count 11,600/mm3, Platelet_Count 221,000/mm3, Urea_Nitrogen 26 mg/dL, Glucose 122 mg/dL, Creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Total 3.6 mg

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely viral or drug-induced).

The clinical picture of fever, RUQ tenderness, jaundice, dark urine, and elevated bilirubin confirms hepatocellular injury. Given the specific exposure at the state fair, we should investigate Hepatitis A. Are you aware of any recent consumption of undercooked shellfish or unpasteurized dairy products?

REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_A_IgM
REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Upper_Quadrant_Ultrasound
